lines.text: The psalm calls the servants who stand in the LORD's house to praise His name because He is good.
The LORD chose Jacob and Israel as His treasured possession, and He does all that pleases Him in heaven, earth and seas.
He struck down the strongest of Egypt, both man and beast, and sent signs and wonders against Pharaoh.
He struck down Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan and Canaan's kings, then gave their land to Israel.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, and the psalm ends by blessing the LORD who dwells in Bethel.
